how_to_run: Two fresh general-purpose agents per case, identical prompt from prompt_template, one with SKILL_PATH = a snapshot of the committed skill, one with the candidate. Run from the opencouncil-tasks checkout so the cwd default is the wrong repo. Grade the preview against the assertions; read both outputs yourself.
prompt_template:
You are helping a non-technical operations teammate file a GitHub issue. Read and follow the skill instructions in this file exactly: {SKILL_PATH}

The teammate's report, verbatim:
---
{REPORT}
---

Constraints for this run:
- You are running from the checkout at /home/kouloumos/schema-labs/projects/opencouncil-tasks (the skill may consult it).
- Read-only GitHub access only: you may run `gh search`, `gh label list`, `gh repo view`, `gh issue view`. Do NOT run `gh issue create`, do NOT post comments, do NOT edit anything on GitHub, do NOT modify files.
- You cannot ask the teammate anything. Wherever the skill would have you ask, write the exact questions under a heading "Questions for the reporter" and fill in whatever you can from the report.
- Stop at the point where the skill would show the preview and wait for approval. Your final message must be that preview, exactly as the skill formats it, plus the questions heading if any. Nothing else.

ground_truth.correct_repo: schemalabz/opencouncil — the speaker title is rendered by src/components/meetings/docx/MinutesDocx.ts
ground_truth.root_cause: src/lib/utils/roles.ts simplifyRoleName keeps everything before 'Αντιδήμαρχος'; the person's role is 'Αναπληρωτής Δήμαρχος - Αντιδήμαρχος …'
ground_truth.reporter_fix_guess: 'His title … must be "Αντιδήμαρχος" and nothing else' is a prescription, not an observation
ground_truth.missing_from_report: which sessions, a link or document
ground_truth.verified_by: reproduction with node on 2026-09-07; live role data via OpenCouncil API

assertions: A1 Preview carries a WHERE slot naming city, administrative body, and meeting/session — filled from the report or listed under Questions for the reporter
A2 Preview separates what the document showed (observed) from what it should have shown (expected) as two distinct fields
A3 Preview carries a SOURCE slot (link, screenshot, or document name) — filled from the report or asked for
A4 Repo chosen is schemalabz/opencouncil, reasoned from the artifact (a generated minutes document), not defaulted from the current checkout
A5 Body contains no fix prescription — no sentence of the form 'the system must/should …', 'the logic should be updated', 'the fallback must be removed'
A6 Evidence the reporter supplied survives into the preview verbatim (names, numbers, links)
A7 Stops at the preview; runs no gh issue create
evals.notes: Assertions written before any run. A1–A3 are slot checks (tier 2). A4 is the routing check: run from the -tasks checkout so a default-to-cwd skill picks the wrong repo. A5 is a shape check: the report itself contains the 'must' sentence, so passing means the skill dropped it, not that the input lacked it.
